description: This file defines a service for aggregating LLM (Large Language Model) costs by agent name, including functions for resolving collection names, building MongoDB aggregation pipelines for different data schemas, and a fallback in-process aggregation method. It exports functions to retrieve cost data and perform in-memory aggregation.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates
methods.description: Determines collection names from environment variables and defaults, prioritizing 'llm-costs' and related collections.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for flat schema documents with various agent and cost fields, normalizing and summing costs.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for documents with an 'Agents' array, normalizing agent names and summing costs.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp
methods.description: Performs in-memory aggregation of agent costs from an array of documents, used as fallback.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent
methods.description: Main exported function that attempts to retrieve aggregated LLM costs by agent from the database, with fallback to in-memory aggregation if needed.
